documents.title: Introduction to Pixeltable
documents.body: One application file. Insert runs compute. Tables, computed columns, indexes, and HTTP routes are declared in app.py. pxt schema update creates the catalog tables. It does not start HTTP.

documents.title: Computed Columns
documents.body: An annotation is a stored column. An assignment is a computed column. Insert a row and the assigned columns run. Indexes stay current. You do not orchestrate a second job to refresh them.

documents.title: Export to SQL
documents.body: export_sql writes selected columns to a SQL database such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Snowflake, or TigerData. Type mapping is automatic. Compute in Pixeltable, then export_sql to the serving database.

documents.title: Media Processing
documents.body: Iterators are functions. frame_iterator, string_splitter, and document_splitter turn one inserted row into many view rows. Put destination= on the assigned column to write generated media to a bucket.

documents.title: Ephemeral Deployment
documents.body: A batch job applies the application file, inserts rows, lets computed columns run, exports, and exits. The catalog can live under PIXELTABLE_HOME in the container. Cloud is pxt schema update app.py pxt://org:db. There is no HTTP on that path.
